Why does the `E2E_AGENT` variable not work, again?

Because this workflow runs `mise run test:e2e:canary`, and that task ignores any incoming `E2E_AGENT`.

In [mise-tasks/test/e2e/canary](/Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.worktrees/feat/checkpoints-v2-close-test-gaps/mise-tasks/test/e2e/canary), the agent is hardcoded at the command level:

```sh
...
E2E_AGENT=roger-roger gotestsum ...
```

Those inline assignments override the workflow’s env block, so this in the workflow:

```yaml
env:
  E2E_AGENT: ${{ inputs.agent }}
```

never affects the actual test process.

So if a user selected `codex`, `claude-code`, or anything else, the canary task still ran `vogon` and `roger-roger`, because the task script explicitly forced those values.
